The website of Caleb Waldorf

I create publishing frameworks, collaborative pedagogical structures, and digital platforms with art institutions, treating each as a way to align organizational form with the social relations they enact.

For over a decade, this practice centered on two projects: The Public School, a school with no curriculum, in which classes emerged from proposals submitted by the public; and Triple Canopy, which I co-founded and where, as creative director, I worked across design and technical direction. Alongside these, I initiated shorter-term projects, including A Public Library, a reading and discussion space embedded within a Berlin city library.

With The Museum of Modern Art, I conceived and developed post, and am currently developing the concept and structure for an online platform at the Hamburger Bahnhof. More recently, I started eeeeee, a project that publishes and distributes works in collaboration with artists and independent presses.
